book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第三册
unit_cn: Unit 1 It's All About Me! 一切关乎我
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修三 Unit 1 词表(p111-112 真词);IPA 标准词典英音;例句原创、自我认同/外貌/社交媒体主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。专有名词跳过。

words.meaning_cn: 自我批评的;自我批判的
words.example_en: Many people are the most self-critical about their own looks.
words.example_cn: 许多人对自己的外貌最为苛刻。

words.example_en: Each kind comment seemed to boost her confidence a little.
words.example_cn: 每一句善意的评论似乎都能稍稍增强她的自信。

words.example_en: People who pretend to be someone else often misjudge themselves.
words.example_cn: 假装成别人的人往往会误判自己。

words.meaning_cn: 完全相同的;非常相似的
words.example_en: He owned five identical shirts and wore them day after day.
words.example_cn: 他有五件一模一样的衬衫,日复一日地穿。

words.example_en: When he moved into the dormitory, his roommates were confused.
words.example_cn: 他搬进宿舍时,室友们感到困惑。

words.example_en: For a long time, her weight really bothered her.
words.example_cn: 很长一段时间,她的体重真的让她很苦恼。

words.example_en: She tried diets and weight-loss pills, but they only harmed her health.
words.example_cn: 她试过节食和减肥药,但这些只损害了她的健康。

words.example_en: She has acknowledged that good health makes us more beautiful.
words.example_cn: 她已经承认,健康让我们更美。

words.example_en: We should not make assumptions about who is truly happy.
words.example_cn: 我们不应臆断谁才是真正快乐的人。

words.example_en: He spent all his savings on new clothes for the makeover.
words.example_cn: 他把全部积蓄都花在了为改造形象买的新衣服上。

words.example_en: The programme cares about the mental welfare of young people.
words.example_cn: 这个节目关心年轻人的心理健康。

words.example_en: A teacher of psychology explained why we keep editing our photos.
words.example_cn: 一位心理学老师解释了我们为何不停地修图。

words.example_en: The findings of the scar experiment surprised everyone.
words.example_cn: 疤痕实验的研究结果让所有人都很惊讶。

words.example_en: The French novelist wrote about beauty hidden behind an ugly face.
words.example_cn: 这位法国小说家描写了丑陋面孔背后隐藏的美。

words.example_en: How he could be so cruel was beyond her comprehension.
words.example_cn: 他怎么会如此残忍,这超出了她的理解。

words.example_en: She noticed a sad accent in the way the lonely man spoke.
words.example_cn: 她注意到那个孤独男人说话时带着一种悲伤的语气。

words.example_en: His real motive was to win praise from others online.
words.example_cn: 他真正的动机是赢得网上他人的赞美。

words.example_en: The selfie app could remove every freckle from her face.
words.example_cn: 这款自拍软件能去掉她脸上的每一颗雀斑。

words.example_en: With one tap the app could enlarge her eyes and slim her jaw.
words.example_cn: 轻轻一点,软件就能放大她的眼睛、瘦脸。

words.example_en: Her father called her a narcissist for editing so many selfies.
words.example_cn: 她父亲因为她修了太多自拍而说她自恋。

words.example_en: His obsessive photo editing showed a lack of self-confidence.
words.example_cn: 他对修图的痴迷反映出缺乏自信。

words.example_en: People who hide their real selves tend to misjudge themselves.
words.example_cn: 隐藏真实自我的人往往会错看自己。

words.example_en: His sister owned seventeen lipsticks and could never choose one.
words.example_cn: 他姐姐有十七支口红,却总也选不出一支。

words.example_en: His roommates secretly signed him up for a makeover show.
words.example_cn: 他的室友们偷偷给他报名了一档形象改造节目。

words.example_en: Being reviewed from head to toe felt bizarre to him at first.
words.example_cn: 被从头到脚地评头论足,起初让他觉得很别扭。

words.example_en: After the makeover, he finally saw himself as handsome.
words.example_cn: 改造之后,他终于觉得自己很帅。

words.example_en: Inner beauty matters most, but outer beauty should not be overlooked.
words.example_cn: 内在美最重要,但外在美也不应被忽视。

words.meaning_cn: 模式化的成见;刻板印象
words.example_en: She stayed confident in an industry full of beauty stereotypes.
words.example_cn: 在一个充满审美刻板印象的行业里,她依然自信。

words.example_en: She would rather be large and happy than skinny and unhealthy.
words.example_cn: 她宁愿丰满而快乐,也不愿骨瘦如柴又不健康。

words.example_en: People thought the character looked frightful, but he was kind.
words.example_cn: 人们觉得这个角色样子可怕,但他其实很善良。

words.example_en: Despite his monstrous appearance, he had a gentle heart.
words.example_cn: 尽管外表骇人,他却有一颗温柔的心。

words.example_en: He may seem strange, yet he is just and righteous inside.
words.example_cn: 他看上去也许怪异,但内心正直公道。

words.example_en: His outward appearance hid a timid and sensitive character.
words.example_cn: 他外表之下藏着一颗胆怯而敏感的心。

words.example_en: Behind his fierce face was a timid and gentle soul.
words.example_cn: 凶猛的面孔背后,是一个胆怯而温和的灵魂。

words.example_en: He believes he is a coward, yet he acts bravely when afraid.
words.example_cn: 他认为自己是懦夫,但害怕时仍勇敢行事。

words.example_en: The bookish boy with untidy hair was braver than he looked.
words.example_cn: 那个头发乱乱、爱读书的男孩比看上去要勇敢。

words.example_en: In reality, he is brave, loyal and always ready to help.
words.example_cn: 实际上,他勇敢、忠诚,而且随时愿意帮忙。

words.example_en: She was as graceful as he was plain and repulsive.
words.example_cn: 她有多优雅,他就有多平凡而丑陋。

words.example_en: Many people found him repulsive, yet she felt only pity.
words.example_cn: 很多人觉得他令人厌恶,而她只感到怜悯。

words.example_en: Every moment she noticed a fresh defect in his face.
words.example_cn: 每一刻她都会发现他脸上一处新的缺陷。

words.example_en: She spoke with heartfelt compassion for the lonely man.
words.example_cn: 她带着真挚的怜悯对那个孤独的人说话。

words.example_en: Next to her exquisite beauty, he felt even uglier.
words.example_cn: 在她精致的美貌旁,他觉得自己更丑了。

words.example_en: When he compared himself to her, he felt immense pity.
words.example_cn: 当他把自己和她相比时,感到无比的自怜。

words.example_en: He said he must resemble some savage creature to her.
words.example_cn: 他说,在她眼里他一定像某种野蛮的怪物。

words.example_en: She listened to him with profound tenderness.
words.example_cn: 她带着深切的温柔听他诉说。

words.example_en: Her heartfelt words showed how deeply she cared.
words.example_cn: 她诚挚的话语显示出她有多么在乎。

words.example_en: The app could slim her jawline with a single tap.
words.example_cn: 这款软件轻轻一点就能让她的下巴线条变瘦。

words.example_en: A look of tenderness slowly softened her face.
words.example_cn: 一抹柔情渐渐让她的脸庞柔和起来。
